error_summary: Cell is outside active grid domain: 110 errors in Stonehenge2.chd; 105 HFB connection exclusions

root_cause_diagnosis.mechanism: Line 1 contains a text header comment (# Approved-polygon...). In MODFLOW 6 OPEN/CLOSE array reading, ASCII characters were parsed as integer data, shifting the numerical IDOMAIN array by 26 elements (exactly 1 row) in Fortran memory, causing boundary cells and HFB cell pairs to fall into misaligned/inactive cells.
